verdict.rationale: Retell documents custom functions that call your API mid-call, with configurable URL, method, headers, parameters, and responses. It also documents function calling against external APIs and connecting to remote MCP servers whose tools the agent can call during a live call. This clearly delivers the core of the story. Missing for 10: any evidence of latency masking or filler speech while a tool runs (the "no awkward dead air" part), details on how results are spoken back, and independent or hands-on corroboration of mid-call tool calling.
